**Kispang shelter is cut off.** Its only road, to Nilkantha village, is impassable, so car1 cannot leave. No car can reach anyone, and no one can be brought to the only evacuation point. Everyone has to be deferred to a later rescue wave.

<plan>
defer kalika-market child 3
defer galchhi-school child 4
</plan>

- Kalika market: 3 children × 60 = 180
- Galchhi school: 4 children × 60 = 240
- Driving: 0 minutes
